production.order: Generate q03 first (the hardest: writing has to read as writing, with a pen and a page, and the page must stay unreadable) and inspect it at 900/360/250/180 px and in the centered 4:5 crop before sending the rest; then q01, q02 and q04. shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture, soft natural light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere: book covers and spines are plain solid colors, cups and packaging are plain, and any page shows only faint, unreadable lines. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos.
shared_prompts.safe_center: Keep the person, both hands and the object of the action inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps them whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.
shared_prompts.solo: Only this one person is in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.
shared_prompts.action: The action is the most obvious thing in the photo: the camera is at eye level a few steps away, the face is fully visible and in sharp focus, and the person is seen from the head to the waist or lower, with the hands and the object clearly visible.
